hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-light
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-none font-normal

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, p-12.
spacing_and_layout.grid: Control Room Grid but with more breathing room. gap-6 or gap-8.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-none or max rounded-sm (2px) for a sharp, tailored luxury feel.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense data, center-align hero elements.

surfaces_and_borders.cards: Flat background (#141414) with a subtle 1px border (border-subtle). No drop shadow. Hover effect: slight border brighten (border-active).
surfaces_and_borders.header: Crystal Glass variant or Solid #0A0A0A with a 1px bottom border.
surfaces_and_borders.buttons: Primary buttons: Gold background (#C6A96B) with Black text. Secondary buttons: Transparent background with Gold border.

animations.general: Subtle, smooth, and discreet. No bouncy or playful animations.
animations.hover: Fade transitions on borders and text colors. Very slight background color shifts.

components.navigation: Side or top nav with clear hierarchy. Logo in Playfair Display. Links use Manrope.
components.cards: Property and Vendor cards should use images prominently. Use bg-black/40 overlay to ensure text contrast.
components.tables: Staff and Vendor tables. Left aligned text. Generous row padding (py-4). Subtle border-bottom for rows.
components.forms: Inputs with flat black background, subtle gold bottom border. Focus state thickens gold border. No outline.
components.ai_assistant: Floating or embedded chat interface. Extremely minimal. 'Neapolitan Intelligence' placeholder. Quiet and discreet.

estates.description: Modern mansion with poolside view at sunset

lifestyle.description: Elegant interior of a private jet

staff.description: Pouring a drink for a guest

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Set background to #0A0A0A and text to #F8F6F2 globally. 2. Use Playfair Display for headers and Manrope for body text. 3. Add 1px subtle gold borders (#C6A96B at 15% opacity) for cards and sections. 4. Implement all UI elements with a flat, sharp, minimalist aesthetic. No heavy dropshadows or extreme rounded corners. 5. Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements. 6. The vibe is 'quiet luxury' — highly functional but looks like a million dollars.
